title: One overlap equation remains effective at later stages
statement: Let I be a nonempty directed preorder and D : Iᵒᵖ → Scheme a diagram of qcqs schemes with affine transition maps, with limit cone c and fixed i₀. Let G be a sheaf of sets on D(i₀), and W,U,V qcqs etale objects over D(i₀), with f : U → W and g : V → W. Fix j in Over(i₀ᵒᵖ) and sections s,t on the stage-j base changes of U,V. Suppose that for every etale Z and p : Z → U, q : Z → V with pf=qg the two restrictions have equal images under the limit section comparison of def-weil-pbc-sets-section-comparison. There exist l and d : l → j such that for every k and e : k → l and every etale Y over D(k), restrictions of the two sections transported along e then d agree along any a : Y → U_k, a′ : Y → V_k with af_k=a′g_k.

source.document: Stacks Project, Étale Cohomology, Tags 03Q4 and 09YQ

proof.text: Apply the qcqs overlap restriction detector to obtain Z,p,q. Restrict the two sections to Z. Apply eventual equality using the assumed limit equation on p,q. Thinness identifies its two arrows to j.

At any further stage, apply the transition comparison to the equality on Z. The composition law identifies the resulting sections with their transport along the composite arrow. Restriction naturality moves the composite comparisons past p and q. Apply the overlap detector at that base change to the given Y,a,a′.
